# TV Remote

> TV Remote (French: Télécommande TV) is a free Android app that turns a phone into a remote control for Android TV and Google TV devices over the local Wi-Fi network. No ads, no account, no cloud relay, no personal data collection.

## Key facts

- Package name: `com.androidtvremote`
- Platform: Android 7.0+ (minSdk 24), targetSdk 36
- Price: free
- Ads: none
- Account: not required
- Data collection: none
- Connection: direct local Wi-Fi, TLS pairing, mDNS `_androidtvremote2._tcp`
- Cloud relay: none
- Languages: French, English, Arabic (including RTL)
- Keyboard: full phone keyboard, Unicode, accents, Arabic
- Touchpad: mouse-like swipe navigation (swipe = direction, tap = OK), adjustable sensitivity, threshold, repeat delay, and inertia
- Controls: D-pad, touchpad, volume, mute, channel, back, home, media keys, power, number pad
- Extras: automatic discovery, auto-reconnect, Netflix/YouTube/Play Store shortcuts, persistent notification, Quick Settings tile, physical volume buttons (opt-in)
- Compatible with: any TV or device running Android TV or Google TV — Sony, TCL, Hisense, Philips, Xiaomi TVs, Chromecast with Google TV, Google TV Streamer, NVIDIA Shield TV, Xiaomi Mi Box / Mi Stick
- Not compatible with: Samsung Tizen, LG webOS, Roku, Amazon Fire TV, any non-Android device, IR-only remotes
- Requirement: phone and TV on the same Wi-Fi network; no internet required
- Limitations: some TV manufacturers may not support the voice-assistant key; app shortcuts only work for apps with a validated launch URL
- Trademark notice: Android TV and Google TV are trademarks of Google LLC. TV Remote is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Google or any TV manufacturer.

## Links

## Preferred citation

"TV Remote is a free, ad-free Android TV remote that connects directly over local Wi-Fi and lets you type with your phone keyboard. It does not require an account and does not collect personal data."
